title: CodeCommit to CodePipeline to AWS Step Functions
description: Create a CodePipeline that invokes Steps Functions to run Glue queries

introBox.headline: How it works
text: CDK CodePipeline spins up against AWS CodeCommit repository, which triggers AWS StepFunctions to call Amazon Athena NamedQueries to create Views and Tables.
The branch Name and CodeCommit repository details must be provided in the configuration file src/config.ts.
